item.title: Network Netoraru Kare Machi Kanojo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Teatime
  • 発売日: 2012-06-15
  • スコア: 6.14/10 (33 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ネトワクネトラル カレマチカノジョ
  • 英語名: Network Netoraru Kare Machi Kanojo

别名

  • KareKano

あらすじ

The protagonist had a dream where he met his girlfriend. He woke up only to find a goddess of love besides him. The goddess gave him a database of girls that he could capture by raising flags called the “Onago” database.

This game features customization (separate from main-game) where players can create their own heroine. There are large numbers of traits that can be selected, including traits similar to other anime characters. Players can view and use their customization data by opening up the Onago Database. Said heroine can be used by other players through online mode.

item.title: Ren'ai + H
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Teatime
  • 発売日: 2011-05-27
  • スコア: 5.75/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋愛＋H
  • 英語名: Ren’ai + H

あらすじ

This is TEATIME’s 18+ answer to the popular Love Plus. Not storyline to follow, just a free reign SLG adventure with your bishoujo of choice. You get to choose between cheerful ojou-sama Ayano, tsundere ‘imouto’ Saki and calm ‘onee-san’ Nana. You can customize her appearance and personality and then take her out on a date. Will you hold hands, share a passionate kiss, or maybe…? It’s up for you to decide! There’s also pocky and jankenpon mini games.
